example_en: The artist paid homage to his mentor in his latest work.
example_zh: 這位藝術家在他最新的作品中向他的導師致敬。

example_en: It is important to discern the truth from lies.
example_zh: 辨別真相與謊言是很重要的。

example_en: He decided to renege on his promise to help.
example_zh: 他決定違背對幫助的承諾。

example_en: The speaker's cadence captivated the audience.
example_zh: 演講者的韻律吸引了觀眾。

example_en: She managed to extricate herself from the difficult situation.
example_zh: 她成功地脫離了困難的情況。

example_en: Don't fret about the small details.
example_zh: 不要為小細節煩惱。

example_en: The raucous crowd cheered for their team.
example_zh: 喧鬧的人群為他們的隊伍歡呼。

meaning_zh: 長篇激烈的演說或責罵
example_en: She launched into a tirade about the unfair treatment at work.
example_zh: 她對工作中的不公平待遇展開了一場激烈的責罵。

example_en: His animus towards the team was evident in his comments.
example_zh: 他對團隊的敵意在他的評論中顯而易見。

example_en: She wore a demure dress to the formal event.
example_zh: 她在正式活動中穿了一件端莊的裙子。

example_en: Her performance was impeccable and received a standing ovation.
example_zh: 她的表現無可挑剔，獲得了全場起立鼓掌。

example_en: It's not right to disparage others to make yourself feel better.
example_zh: 貶低他人以讓自己感覺更好是不對的。

example_en: She tried to pry into his personal life.
example_zh: 她試圖探聽他的私生活。

example_en: She decided to confide in her best friend about her worries.
example_zh: 她決定向最好的朋友吐露自己的擔憂。

example_en: The warm light seemed to emanate from the fireplace.
example_zh: 溫暖的光似乎從壁爐中散發出來。

example_en: The judge granted him a reprieve from his sentence.
example_zh: 法官給了他暫時解救，免於服刑。

example_en: She is a studious student who always completes her assignments on time.
example_zh: 她是一位勤奮好學的學生，總是準時完成作業。

meaning_zh: 不知所措的，無法反應的
example_en: He felt intransigent in the face of criticism.
example_zh: 面對批評，他感到不知所措。

example_en: Teachers aim to inculcate good habits in their students.
example_zh: 老師的目標是灌輸學生良好的習慣。

example_en: Many people revere their teachers for their guidance.
example_zh: 許多人因為老師的指導而尊敬他們。

meaning_zh: 模仿作品，通常帶有諷刺意味（名詞）
example_en: The movie is a hilarious parody of classic horror films.
example_zh: 這部電影是對經典恐怖片的搞笑模仿。

example_en: Her gullibility often led her to believe in scams.
example_zh: 她的輕信常常讓她相信詐騙。

example_en: The jar was hermetically sealed to preserve the contents.
example_zh: 這個罐子被密封以保存內容物。

example_en: The aphorism 'Actions speak louder than words' is widely known.
example_zh: 名言「行動勝於言辭」廣為人知。

meaning_zh: 子女對父母的孝順（形容詞）
example_en: He showed filial devotion by taking care of his elderly parents.
example_zh: 他通過照顧年邁的父母表現出孝順。

meaning_zh: 受委屈的，受害的 (形容詞)
example_en: She felt aggrieved by the unfair treatment at work.
example_zh: 她對工作中的不公平對待感到受委屈。

meaning_zh: 喋喋不休，洩漏秘密 (動詞)
example_en: She tends to blab about her friends' secrets.
example_zh: 她常常喋喋不休地洩漏朋友的秘密。

example_en: The sky darkened ominously before the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨來臨前，天空不祥地變暗。

example_en: The fabrication of the story was revealed.
example_zh: 這個故事的虛構被揭露了。

meaning_zh: 搜尋可用物品或食物 (動詞)
example_en: The dog began to scavenge for food in the trash.
example_zh: 那隻狗開始在垃圾中搜尋食物。

example_en: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
example_zh: 我們上週末去山上進行了一次短途旅行。

example_en: She managed to concoct a delicious meal from leftovers.
example_zh: 她成功地用剩菜調製了一頓美味的餐點。

example_en: The idea of cheating is repugnant to me.
example_zh: 對我來說，作弊的想法令人厭惡。

meaning_zh: 憤怒的，義憤填膺的 (形容詞)
example_en: She was indignant at the unfair treatment.
example_zh: 她對不公正的對待感到憤怒。

example_en: He tends to squander his money on unnecessary things.
example_zh: 他常常把錢浪費在不必要的東西上。

example_en: The incipient stages of the project require careful planning.
example_zh: 這個項目的初期階段需要仔細規劃。

example_en: She found herself in a difficult predicament.
example_zh: 她發現自己處於一個困難的窘境。

meaning_zh: 沉默寡言，謹言慎行（名詞）
example_en: Her reticence in meetings often left others guessing her true opinions.
example_zh: 她在會議中的沉默寡言常常讓其他人猜測她的真實想法。

example_en: His silence was tantamount to an admission of guilt.
example_zh: 他的沉默相當於承認有罪。

example_en: The movie was filled with risque humor.
example_zh: 這部電影充滿了冒險的幽默。

meaning_zh: 頑抗的；不服從的（形容詞）
example_en: The recalcitrant student refused to follow the teacher's instructions.
example_zh: 那位頑抗的學生拒絕遵從老師的指示。

example_en: He lay prostrate on the ground after the race.
example_zh: 比賽後，他俯臥在地上。

example_en: She took copious notes during the lecture.
example_zh: 她在講座中做了大量筆記。

example_en: The precocious child could solve complex math problems.
example_zh: 這個早熟的孩子能解決複雜的數學問題。

example_en: She covets her neighbor's beautiful garden.
example_zh: 她渴望擁有鄰居美麗的花園。

meaning_zh: 活潑的；充滿生氣的（形容詞）
example_en: Her vivacious personality makes her the life of the party.
example_zh: 她活潑的個性讓她成為派對的靈魂。

meaning_zh: 形容像洞穴般的，空洞的
example_en: The cavernous room echoed with every sound.
example_zh: 那個像洞穴般的房間裡每個聲音都回響。

example_en: She handled the criticism with nonchalance.
example_zh: 她對批評漠不關心。

meaning_zh: 消瘦的，形容身體極度瘦弱
example_en: The emaciated dog wandered the streets in search of food.
example_zh: 那隻消瘦的狗在街上徘徊尋找食物。

meaning_zh: 昏昏欲睡的；無精打采的（形容詞）
example_en: After staying up late, I felt lethargic all day.
example_zh: 熬夜後，我整天感到昏昏欲睡。

example_en: I can only surmise what happened last night.
example_zh: 我只能推測昨晚發生了什麼。

example_en: The dilapidated house stood abandoned for years.
example_zh: 那棟破舊的房子空置了多年。

example_en: The region has sought greater ipunity from the central government.
example_zh: 該地區尋求更大的獨立性以脫離中央政府。

example_en: The criminal acted with impunity, believing he would never be caught.
example_zh: 這名罪犯毫無懼怕地行事，認為自己永遠不會被抓到。

example_en: After traveling so much, he became quite blase about new experiences.
example_zh: 經過這麼多旅行，他對新體驗變得相當冷漠。

example_en: She tries to emulate her older sister's success.
example_zh: 她試圖效法姐姐的成功。

example_en: After years of idealism, he felt a deep sense of disenchantment with politics.
example_zh: 經過多年的理想主義，他對政治感到深深的幻滅。

example_en: She showed her plucky spirit during the competition.
example_zh: 她在比賽中展現了勇敢的精神。

example_en: He did community service as a form of penance.
example_zh: 他做社區服務作為一種懺悔。

meaning_zh: 不相信的，懷疑的（形容詞）
example_en: She gave him an incredulous look when he told her the news.
example_zh: 當他告訴她這個消息時，她給了他一個不相信的眼神。

example_en: The tumultuous crowd cheered for their team.
example_zh: 動盪的人群為他們的隊伍歡呼。

example_en: The dark clouds were an inauspicious sign for the outdoor wedding.
example_zh: 陰雲密布對戶外婚禮來說是不吉利的徵兆。

example_en: Her vanity often leads her to seek constant praise.
example_zh: 她的虛榮心常常使她尋求不斷的讚美。

example_en: He tends to be moralizing in his speeches.
example_zh: 他在演講中常常道德說教。

example_en: They connived to cheat the system.
example_zh: 他們共謀欺騙系統。

example_en: He lay supine on the grass, staring at the clouds.
example_zh: 他仰臥在草地上，凝視著雲朵。

example_en: The banality of the conversation made it hard to stay engaged.
example_zh: 對話的平凡使人難以保持興趣。

example_en: She stood defiantly in front of the crowd.
example_zh: 她挑釁地站在群眾面前。

example_en: The hermit lived alone in the mountains for years.
example_zh: 那位隱士在山中獨自生活了多年。

example_en: The reclusive author rarely made public appearances.
example_zh: 這位隱居的作家很少公開露面。

example_en: The garden was replete with colorful flowers.
example_zh: 花園裡充滿了五彩繽紛的花朵。

example_en: They built a raft to cross the river.
example_zh: 他們搭了一個木筏過河。

example_en: The intrepid explorer ventured into the uncharted territory.
example_zh: 那位勇敢的探險家冒險進入未知的領域。

example_en: He is a contrarian who often challenges popular opinions.
example_zh: 他是一個經常挑戰流行觀點的反對者。

example_en: She has always been passionate about equestrian sports.
example_zh: 她一直對馬術運動充滿熱情。

meaning_zh: 平凡無奇的；無特徵的 (形容詞)
example_en: The building was nondescript and easily overlooked.
example_zh: 那棟建築平凡無奇，容易被忽視。

meaning_zh: 壯觀的；令人印象深刻的（形容詞）
example_en: The imposing castle stood on the hilltop.
example_zh: 那座壯觀的城堡矗立在山頂上。

example_en: The wedding ritual was beautifully performed.
example_zh: 婚禮儀式表演得非常美麗。

meaning_zh: 挑剔的，過分講究的 (形容詞)
example_en: She is fastidious about her appearance.
example_zh: 她對自己的外表非常挑剔。

example_en: She spoke of the teacher with great reverence.
example_zh: 她對老師充滿了崇敬之情。

example_en: I have to do my chores before I can go out.
example_zh: 我必須先做完家務，才能出去。

example_en: His comportment during the meeting was very professional.
example_zh: 他在會議中的舉止非常專業。
